description.value: You fire a focused pulse tuned to scramble either synthetic processors or organic nerves. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a construct is stunned for the duration, while a living creature is poisoned for the duration. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 4
